limitations: Bounded runs on one Pixel 8a, not endurance or a proof of memory plateau.
The baseline and corrected binaries differ; the separately published instrumented purge experiment is not the production policy.
No forced GC, global context/UI-recorder cache purge, input downscaling, quota increase or system setting changes.
Callback timing is not presented/decoded FPS. There is no controlled Skia 2 or cross-platform speed comparison.

The original collector marked noCachePurge=true because it sends no external purge; the export-cache binary itself trims its private recorder at session close. This summary describes the actual binary policy.

limits: Compares sampled decoded SDR pixels, not full-image fidelity or HDR.
This validation reads GPU pixels; its runtime and memory are not performance measurements.
Device memory and post-GC cleanup are qualified by the separate benchmark campaign.
